notes.title: Reviews
notes.content:
We don’t have many reviews of the game and we want to change that so we thought we should reward players for leaving a review of the game.

Reviews really help us understand what we did right and what we did wrong so we don’t do the same mistakes in our next game.

When you leave a review (positive or negative) with a gameplay of over 2 hours, we send you 50% back of whatever you paid. You can simply send us a friend request and message us you your Paypal email and a screenshot of the game receipt and we will send you the reward to your Paypal.

Thank you.

notes.title: Last Steam Update
notes.content:
After a long absence, we are back to provide you with a cool and sadly the last update of the game in Steam. Hold tight because we added a lot of improvements to the game:

- We optimized the game as best we could so it can run on a very very low end computer with the best graphics possible.
- We added a control meter to make the game more skillful.
- We improved the AI of the guards.
- We fixed every flaw about the game we can think of.
- Joysticks are now auto detected, no need to assign them anymore. (Game best played with joystick)
- We balanced the game so it’s not too hard and not too easy.

So what’s next?

That is actually up to you, the player. If you played the game and loved the concept and originality of it then just post a nice review about it. The more reviews, the more sales, the more sales, the more resources we have to work on the next title of the Tidal Affair series and we have plenty of ideas and fresh concepts we want to implement.

Thank you so much for being a fan!

notes.title: Game Update #5
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are glad to announce that we just placed a new update that contains the following features:

1. Controller Support: now you can play with your favourite controller and surprisingly the game plays and feels much better with a controller. We recommend a PS4 controller. The only thing missing with a controller is UI navigation but we'll get to it next update.

2. Controller Mapping:  you can now map the controls to your liking from the Controls Menu. 

3. Some Level Design improvements.

Next update we hope to add Steam Cloud and please if you have any suggestion open a thread and we'll look into adding it.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Tidal Affair: Before The Storm is finally out!
notes.content:
Tidal Affair: Before The Storm is out now as full release and we believe the current state of the game will let you have an enjoyable experience and give you a taste of what’s to come in the Tidal Affair series.

If you have any request such as controller support or controller mapping, please let us know and we will get it done for you.

Thank you so much on behalf of Overcurfew!

notes.title: Game Update #4
notes.content:
Hello again. We are exactly one day away from final release! We are very excited and scared at the same time as we don’t know where we stand among all the AAA releases. This last Early Access update contains a lot of polish and fixes but we still have to update about half of the cutscenes that are going in just in time for release.

Updates:
# Added all remaining visual effects.
# Big improvements in the training sessions. 
# Milestone: All bugs are fixed! Well at least the ones we know about :p
# Finished all remaining game SFX.
# Fixed all game visual glitches.
# The island is well connected now and transitions are much smoother.
# Polished some gameplay elements.
# Chapter 2, 3, 4 and 9 cutscenes are final.

Anything else we add to gameplay from this point on will be if you ask for it so don't hesitate to let us know if there is something you want to see in the game and we'll see what we can do.

Thank you.

notes.title: Game Update #3
notes.content:
Here we are with another update of the game and this is what we added this time:

1. Added 5 Game Achievements and tested them. Hopefully they work for everyone this time!
2. Added 3 new Puzzles.
3. Added new game SFX.
4. Fixed few bugs.
5. Polished some levels.
6. Finished a rough version of Chapter 15.
7. Improved the Map.

The list of items for the game is getting very short now and we hope to cover it by next update then only cutscenes will be left and they will most likely all be updated at once.

Thanks again! 
Enjoy your day.

notes.title: Game Update #2
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce some new updates:

1. Improved the level design of practically all Levels. 
2. Fixed a handful of bugs and we now only have very few left :)
3. Polished the visuals of the last few areas of the game.
4. The guards are a bit smarter now. Hopefully that won't make the game harder :P
5. Polished a couple of SFX.
6. Added Splash Screen SFX.

We are currently working hard at putting together the audio and music of all cutscenes as well as polishing the visuals.

Thank you all for being fan of our game and being patient as we are getting close to the finish line.

notes.title: Game Update #1
notes.content:
We are excited to make our first update of the game since it launched in Early Access. This is what the update includes:

1. Improved Overall Performance
2. Improved Controls
3. Added Training for Patches
4. Added Patches Description in Pause Menu
5. Improved some Levels and added more items throughout the game.

Next Update in few days should include the following:
* Polished visuals and level design
* More cutscenes with audio
